sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a1.atom_id) 
FROM atom AS a1 
JOIN connected AS c1 ON a1.atom_id = c1.atom_id 
JOIN bond AS b1 ON c1.bond_id = b1.bond_id 
WHERE b1.bond_type = '#' AND (a1.element = 'p' OR a1.element = 'br')
